title: Emergency Plan Summary and Evacuation Drill Record
subtitle: Mossel Bay Cold Storage, Voorbaai depot. Plan reviewed March 2026; drill held 21 April 2026

blocks.p: This summary covers the Voorbaai depot (fictitious address: 8 Kaap Street, Voorbaai, Mossel Bay): two cold rooms, the blast freezer, the ammonia plant room, the loading dock and the office block, with usually 46 people on day shift and 12 on night shift. It plans for fire, an ammonia release, a person trapped in a cold room or the blast freezer, a serious injury or medical emergency, and a security emergency at the dock. The full plan, the site plan and the fire risk assessment are filed with this summary.
